axis: Expose fake understanding. Every claim explains HOW, not just WHAT.

questions.question: REQUIRED: at least 12 'how/why/mechanism/because' markers per 1000 words?
REQUIRED: no AI/ML buzzwords used without mechanism (deep learning, neural net, transformer)?

questions.pattern: (CAN (traffic|message|frame|bus)|hydraulic pressure|sensor (drift|threshold)|current spike|temperature gradient|J1939 signal|controller area network)
questions.question: REQUIRED: predictive diagnostics explained with specific signal (CAN traffic, current spike, etc.)?

questions.pattern: (autoencoder|isolation forest|gradient boost|random forest|XGBoost|LightGBM|LSTM|conv neural|kalman filter|statistical anomaly|threshold model|rule-based)
questions.question: REQUIRED: when ML claimed, model TYPE named (autoencoder, isolation forest, etc.)?
REQUIRED: false-positive rate or error bound stated?
REQUIRED: inference latency or compute budget named?
REQUIRED: at least one failure mode explained mechanically (why it could fail)?

patterns: \b(was determined|has been shown|is believed|is understood|are considered|will be)\b
questions.question: Optional: no key claims in passive voice without agent ('was determined', 'has been shown')?
